output: Annual plans can only be refunded within 14 days of purchase, and 20 days is past that window, so I can't confirm a refund under the standard policy. I don't have a 60-day window, and I'm sorry the earlier answer gave you a different number. You can cancel any time and keep Pro access until the end of the year you've already paid for. If you think your case deserves an exception, email billing@lumen.io with your account email, purchase date, and the amount, and the team can review it, though I can't say how they'll decide.
